Description: Zero Empty Spaces is a community-focused retail arts marketplace dedicated to displaying, promoting, and selling artwork, handcrafted goods, design products, apparel, books, home goods, prints, and other merchandise created by local artists, makers, designers, and small businesses. Accessory activities may include artist meet-and-greets, live creative displays, merchandise launches, directly related to merchandise offered for sale. These activities are incidental and subordinate to the principal mercantile use and are intended to enhance the customer retail experience while supporting the display and sale of locally produced goods. Limited on-site preparation of merchandise, including assembling displays, and inventory management, may occur. No industrial manufacturing, heavy fabrication, or large-scale production will take place on the premises. The business will operate as a neighborhood-serving retail establishment that encourages pedestrian activity, supports local commerce, and provides customers the opportunity to discover and purchase locally produced goods in a professionally managed commercial environment. Primary Occupancy/Use: Mercantile (Retail Sales and Display of Merchandise to the General Public).
